name: stripe
description: Stripe payments — create hosted Checkout Sessions so a frame can take card payment without ever touching card details
setup_steps: Create a Stripe account, then open Developers → API keys.
START WITH A TEST KEY (it begins sk_test_). Test keys take fake cards and move no real money — use one until you have placed a few orders end to end and are happy with what the customer sees.

Paste the secret key below. It is stored on this device and is never given to frame code: frames ask the platform to call Stripe on their behalf, so a frame can create a payment but can never read your key.
Switch to the live key (sk_live_) only when you are ready to take real money. Anyone you have made an editor of a space can then create charges against this account from a frame that uses it.
usage: invoke('stripe', 'v1/checkout/sessions', { mode: 'payment', success_url: '...', cancel_url: '...', line_items: [{ quantity: 2, price_data: { currency: 'usd', unit_amount: 350, product_data: { name: 'Flat white' } } }] })

methods.name: v1/checkout/sessions
methods.description: Create a hosted Checkout Session and get back a `url` to send the customer to. Card details are entered on Stripe's page, never in the frame.

methods.name: v1/payment_links
methods.description: Create a reusable payment link for a fixed set of items.

api_key.label: Secret key (start with a test key: sk_test_…)
